1.web: He entered and was passing through Jericho.
1.asv: And he entered and was passing through Jericho.

2.web: There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.
2.asv: And behold, a man called by name Zacchæus; and he was a chief publican, and he was rich.

3.web: He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn’t because of the crowd, because he was short.
3.asv: And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the crowd, because he was little of stature.

4.web: He ran on ahead, and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was to pass that way.
4.asv: And he ran on before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.

5.web: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, “Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.”
5.asv: And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and said unto him, Zacchæus, make haste, and come down; for to-day I must abide at thy house.

6.web: He hurried, came down, and received him joyfully.
6.asv: And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully.

7.web: When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, “He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.”
7.asv: And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, He is gone in to lodge with a man that is a sinner.

8.web: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much.”
8.asv: And Zacchæus stood, and said unto the Lord, Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have wrongfully exacted aught of any man, I restore fourfold.

9.web: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.
9.asv: And Jesus said unto him, To-day is salvation come to this house, forasmuch as he also is a son of Abraham.

10.web: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”
10.asv: For the Son of man came to seek and to save that which was lost.

11.web: As they heard these things, he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they supposed that the Kingdom of God would be revealed immediately.
11.asv: And as they heard these things, he added and spake a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they supposed that the kingdom of God was immediately to appear.

12.web: He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.
12.asv: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country, to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.

13.web: He called ten servants of his, and gave them ten mina coins, and told them, ‘Conduct business until I come.’
13.asv: And he called ten servants of his, and gave them ten pounds, and said unto them, Trade ye herewith till I come.

14.web: But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’t want this man to reign over us.’
14.asv: But his citizens hated him, and sent an ambassage after him, saying, We will not that this man reign over us.

15.web: “When he had come back again, having received the kingdom, he commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by conducting business.
15.asv: And it came to pass, when he was come back again, having received the kingdom, that he commanded these servants, unto whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by trading.

16.web: The first came before him, saying, ‘Lord, your mina has made ten more minas.’
16.asv: And the first came before him, saying, Lord, thy pound hath made ten pounds more.

17.web: “He said to him, ‘Well done, you good servant! Because you were found faithful with very little, you shall have authority over ten cities.’
17.asv: And he said unto him, Well done, thou good servant: because thou wast found faithful in a very little, have thou authority over ten cities.

18.web: “The second came, saying, ‘Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.’
18.asv: And the second came, saying, Thy pound, Lord, hath made five pounds.

19.web: “So he said to him, ‘And you are to be over five cities.’
19.asv: And he said unto him also, Be thou also over five cities.

20.web: Another came, saying, ‘Lord, behold, your mina, which I kept laid away in a handkerchief,
20.asv: And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is thy pound, which I kept laid up in a napkin:

21.web: for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn’t lay down, and reap that which you didn’t sow.’
21.asv: for I feared thee, because thou art an austere man: thou takest up that which thou layedst not down, and reapest that which thou didst not sow.

22.web: “He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth will I judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man, taking up that which I didn’t lay down, and reaping that which I didn’t sow.
22.asv: He saith unto him, Out of thine own mouth will I judge thee, thou wicked servant. Thou knewest that I am an austere man, taking up that which I laid not down, and reaping that which I did not sow;

23.web: Then why didn’t you deposit my money in the bank, and at my coming, I might have earned interest on it?’
23.asv: then wherefore gavest thou not my money into the bank, and I at my coming should have required it with interest?

24.web: He said to those who stood by, ‘Take the mina away from him, and give it to him who has the ten minas.’
24.asv: And he said unto them that stood by, Take away from him the pound, and give it unto him that hath the ten pounds.

25.web: “They said to him, ‘Lord, he has ten minas!’
25.asv: And they said unto him, Lord, he hath ten pounds.

26.web: ‘For I tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.
26.asv: I say unto you, that unto every one that hath shall be given; but from him that hath not, even that which he hath shall be taken away from him.

27.web: But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’”
27.asv: But these mine enemies, that would not that I should reign over them, bring hither, and slay them before me.

28.web: Having said these things, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.
28.asv: And when he had thus spoken, he went on before, going up to Jerusalem.

29.web: When he drew near to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the mountain that is called Olivet, he sent two of his disciples,
29.asv: And it came to pass, when he drew nigh unto Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount that is called Olivet, he sent two of the disciples,

30.web: saying, “Go your way into the village on the other side, in which, as you enter, you will find a colt tied, whereon no man ever yet sat. Untie it, and bring it.
30.asv: saying, Go your way into the village over against you; in which as ye enter ye shall find a colt tied, whereon no man ever yet sat: loose him, and bring him.

31.web: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ say to him: ‘The Lord needs it.’”
31.asv: And if any one ask you, Why do ye loose him? thus shall ye say, The Lord hath need of him.

32.web: Those who were sent went away, and found things just as he had told them.
32.asv: And they that were sent went away, and found even as he had said unto them.

33.web: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, “Why are you untying the colt?”
33.asv: And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose ye the colt?

34.asv: And they said, The Lord hath need of him.

35.web: They brought it to Jesus. They threw their cloaks on the colt, and set Jesus on them.
35.asv: And they brought him to Jesus: and they threw their garments upon the colt, and set Jesus thereon.

36.web: As he went, they spread their cloaks on the road.
36.asv: And as he went, they spread their garments in the way.

37.web: As he was now getting near, at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen,
37.asv: And as he was now drawing nigh, even at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen;

38.web: saying, “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!”
38.asv: saying, Blessed is the King that cometh in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest.

39.web: Some of the Pharisees from the multitude said to him, “Teacher, rebuke your disciples!”
39.asv: And some of the Pharisees from the multitude said unto him, Teacher, rebuke thy disciples.

40.web: He answered them, “I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.”
40.asv: And he answered and said, I tell you that, if these shall hold their peace, the stones will cry out.

41.web: When he drew near, he saw the city and wept over it,
41.asv: And when he drew nigh, he saw the city and wept over it,

42.web: saying, “If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.
42.asv: saying, If thou hadst known in this day, even thou, the things which belong unto peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.

43.web: For the days will come on you, when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side,
43.asv: For the days shall come upon thee, when thine enemies shall cast up a bank about thee, and compass thee round, and keep thee in on every side,

44.web: and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn’t know the time of your visitation.”
44.asv: and shall dash thee to the ground, and thy children within thee; and they shall not leave in thee one stone upon another; because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.

45.web: He entered into the temple, and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,
45.asv: And he entered into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold,

46.web: saying to them, “It is written, ‘My house is a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a ‘den of robbers’!”
46.asv: saying unto them, It is written, And my house shall be a house of prayer: but ye have made it a den of robbers.

47.web: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests and the scribes and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.
47.asv: And he was teaching daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the principal men of the people sought to destroy him:

48.web: They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.
48.asv: and they could not find what they might do; for the people all hung upon him, listening.
